events.title: Spirefall on Steam Deck - Native, Full Controller Support
events.summary: Spirefall runs natively on Steam Deck The Spirefall demo ships a native Linux/SteamOS build — no Proton, no compatibility layer. Steam picks it automatically on Deck and on desktop Linux, and it runs in the Steam Linux Runtime, so there is nothing to configure: install and play. Here's exactly what that means, and what we tested. events.title: Privacy Update - Statistics now Ask First
events.summary: The demo prompts on first install if the player wants to automatically send gameplay telemetry and crash reports. Opting in can also happen on the All Settings menu. For those that do choose to send anonymous data, it does help us address gameplay/client stability issues within moments of getting the reports and it is much appreciated, but privacy is also important.
